task_prompt: Write a function to find numbers within a given range from startnum ti endnum where every number is divisible by every digit it contains. https://www.w3resource.com/python-exercises/lambda/python-lambda-exercise-24.php
final_code:
def divisible_by_digits(startnum, endnum):
    return [n for n in range(startnum, endnum + 1) if all(int(d) != 0 or n % int(d) == 0 for d in str(n))]
